- Pay attention to local officials and follow their instructions to stay safe from post-storm risks
- Do not touch downed powerlines and report them to local authorities
- Be safe during an outage by only using flashlights or battery-powered lanterns for emergency lighting 
- Use generators safely by keeping them outdoors, protected from rain or flooding, and at least 20 feet from windows, doors, and attached garages
